The **Starbucks Red Cup**, also called the **Starbucks holiday cup**, is a modern Christmas and holiday season tradition[1][2] and promotional campaign operated by coffee chain Starbucks; each winter, some hot drinks served at Starbucks cafés will be served in cups with a red background and various festive designs instead of the regular white cups.
New designs are used each year.
Starbucks have used the campaign to support HIV/AIDS research.
In 2015 the cups were plain red without the festive designs, and were accused of being anti-Christian.
